2558-2829-8347--109.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
2558-2829-8347--109.description:
Cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control, which enters as a 1/1.
Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the 1/1 creature.
Sela triggers. Holding priority, activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Sela trigger, creating a 2/2 creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

1545-4499-8160.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Kwia.
When Kwia enters, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
Repeat.

5231-5254-8122.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
You don't control an Army, or the only Army you do control is the creature with power 4 or greater.
5231-5254-8122.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature with power 4 or greater. If you control an Army, ensure to sacrifice that creature.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Orc Army creature token and putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.
5231-5254-8122.notes: The Orc Army will become a 5/5 due to the counters and the buff provided by The Muckslinger Gang.

728-3558-4053-6989.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds.
Cast Crookshank Kobolds from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

2099-2558-7916.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters, its living weapon ability granted to it by Ekthi triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Sword of the Meek trigger, creating a 0/0 Phyrexian Germ creature token. It'll enter as a 1/1 due to Ekthi's static effect.
When the Phyrexian Germ enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Phyrexian Germ.
Repeat from step 2.

2583-4636-6441.description:
Activate Whirler Virtuoso by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating two 1/1 Thopter artifact creature tokens due to Elspeth, Storm Slayer.
When the tokens enter, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-2897-3455.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-2897-3455.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Vizier of Many Faces and Gigantoplasm each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Vizier of Many Faces trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Gigantoplasm trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-2897-3455.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

2757-4222-7734.description:
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Wakandan Tusker.
Wakandan Tusker triggers, causing you to scry 1 and gain 1 life
Resolve the Earthcraft ability, untapping a basic Island.
Activate a basic Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Wakandan Tusker.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

343-2366-5434-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
343-2366-5434-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Regal Behemoth triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

5457-7500.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures with different powers.
5457-7500.description:
Activate Selvala by tapping it, adding at least six mana of any color.
Activate Ringing Strike Mastery by paying {5}, untapping Selvala.
Repeat.

4559-5805-6798-7306.easyPrerequisites: Two or more opponents have lost life this turn.
4559-5805-6798-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
4559-5805-6798-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gev.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3678-6699-6871-6879.description:
Cast Tooth of Ramos by paying its mana cost.
When Tooth of Ramos enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Tooth of Ramos.
Activate Tooth of Ramos by sacrificing it.
Haru triggers, returning Tooth of Ramos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

1849-3457-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Seeker of Skybreak.
Activate one of the Seeker of Skybreak tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Seeker of Skybreak token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it
with two or more loyalty counters on it

539-1887-3301-3899-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Tezzeret, Betrayer of Flesh
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

250-779-1479-2692-4693.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-2692-4693.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Felidar Retreat and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Overgrown Estate ability
Resolve the Felidar Retreat trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Felidar Retreat triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

2906-5638-7070.notablePrerequisites:
Your opponents have lost at least 2 life this turn.
You control at least four Equipment.
2906-5638-7070.description:
Activate Plate Armor's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The Plate Armor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to Rakdos.
Repeat.

1850-5414-6701.description:
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing a land.
Play the land from your graveyard.
Repeat.
1850-5414-6701.notes: If the land can tap for mana once it enters the battlefield, you can do so for infinite mana.

222-527-2438-3499.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-2438-3499.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Carrion Feeder twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

183-2634-5259.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{R}.
183-2634-5259.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Rude Awakening by paying {4}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Rude Awakening.
Resolve the Rude Awakening copy, untapping all lands you control.
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Rootha by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.

2825-5893.easyPrerequisites: Thoughtweft Gambit exiled by Elite Arcanist.
2825-5893.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {6}.
2825-5893.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping it, adding at least {6}.
Activate Elite Arcanist by paying {6} and tapping it, copying Thoughtweft Gambit and casting the copy without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Thoughtweft Gambit, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.

501-586-2438-5258-5618.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

2178-2511-4170-4871.notablePrerequisites:
Fain does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional artifact.
2178-2511-4170-4871.description:
Activate Fain's third ability by tapping it and sacrificing another artifact, creating a 2/1 Inkling creature token.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the Inkling.
When the Inkling dies, Fain and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Fain trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1365-1379-2034-4853--20.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent was dealt damage this turn.
The creature with bloodthirst does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1365-1379-2034-4853--20.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving the creature with bloodthirst persist until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature with bloodthirst, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, which enters the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to its bloodthirst ability.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Repeat.

358-913-1368-4098.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three additional cards in your graveyard.
358-913-1368-4098.description:
Cast Infernal Plunge for its escape cost by paying {R}, exling three other cards from your graveyard, and sacrificing Stiticher's Supplier.
When Stitcher's Supplier dies, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
Resolve Infernal Plunge, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Signpost Scarecrow by paying {2}, adding {B}.
Cast Stitcher's Supplier for its escape cost by paying {B} and exling three other cards from your graveyard.
When Stitcher's Supplier enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
Repeat.

2146-3260-3540-4740.notablePrerequisites:
"Enchantment" chosen with Cloud Key.
Your life total is at least nine if your storm count is equal to zero, at least six if your storm count is equal to one, at least four if your storm count is equal to two, or at least three otherwise.
2146-3260-3540-4740.description:
Cast Mourning by paying 2 life, targeting K'rrik.
Aetherflux Reservoir and K'rrik trigger.
Resolve the K'rrik trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Aetherflux Reservoir trigger, causing you to gain an amount of life equal to your storm count.
Resolve Mourning, attaching it to K'rrik.
Activate Mourning by paying 2 life, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite life, you may use Aetherflux Reservoir's ability to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

579-1185-1818-2308-2877.notablePrerequisites:
Prize Pig does not have summoning sickness.
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
579-1185-1818-2308-2877.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Healer of the Pride triggers, holding priority, activate Prize Pig by tapping it, adding {2}.
Resolve the Healer of the Pride trigger, causing you to gain 3 life due to Honor Troll.
Prize Pig and Trudge Garden trigger.
Resolve the Prize Pig trigger, putting three ribbon counters of Prize Pig, then removing all ribbon counters from Prize Pig and untapping it.
Resolve the Trudge Garden trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

1636-1776-4348.notablePrerequisites:
Spawning Grounds attached to any Forest you control.
Ley Druid does not have summoning sickness.
1636-1776-4348.description:
Activate the land with Spawning Grounds attached by tapping it, creating a 5/5 Beast creature token.
The Beast enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Activate Ley Druid by tapping it, untapping the land with Spawning Grounds attached.
Repeat.

1178-1494-4017.notablePrerequisites:
Sunbond attached to Sage of Hours.
You control at least three Shrines.
1178-1494-4017.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Honden of Cleansing Fire triggers, causing you to gain at least six life.
Sunbond triggers, putting at least six +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, taking at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

3525-4410-4508.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura and Hermetic Study attached to Malcolm.
Malcolm does not have summoning sickness.
3525-4410-4508.description:
Tap Malcolm to deal 1 damage to target opponent, creating a treasure from Malcolm's trigger.
Sacrifice the treasure token for {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura to untap Malcolm.
Repeat.
